limitations.note: The rewrite registered the write-side Gray pointer but made both Gray pointers capture the next address, changing flag and transfer timing instead of preserving the existing read-side delay and making the write side match it.
The test required empty to assert immediately after the last read, so it validated the rewrite’s timing rather than checking the one-cycle delay retained by the correct fix.

Two Git checks failed in the non-repository workspace and the whitespace check had to be redone with awk, after the first simulation command had already been resubmitted because its cleanup command was rejected.
